description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractQuerySignalMapper that extends AbstractCommandSignalMapper, serving as a base for mapping query signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It specifies supported actions for query commands, particularly the RETRIEVE action.

classes.name: AbstractQuerySignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract base class for mapping query signals, parameterized by the type of Signal it supports.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns the array of TopicPath.Action that this mapper supports, specifically the RETRIEVE action.
